name: Duplicate Page PTI
author: PTI WebTech

sections.description:
Duplicate Page PTI is a simple yet powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to clone any post, page, or custom post type with just one click. Perfect for developers, marketers, and editors who want to reuse content templates and streamline their workflows.

Whether you’re building landing pages, creating similar posts, or need a backup before editing content—this plugin makes it fast and easy.

Features

  • 🔁 One-Click Duplication – Instantly duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types from the admin list view or while editing.
  • ✅ Custom Post Type Support – Works with all registered custom post types.
  • ⚙️ User Role Control – Limit duplication access based on user roles (Coming soon).
  • 🛠️ Clone Title Prefix/Suffix – Optionally add “Copy of” or custom text to cloned post titles (Upcoming feature).
  • 🌐 Multisite Compatible – Supports WordPress multisite environments.
  • 🧩 Lightweight and Fast – Clean codebase optimized for performance.
  • 🎨 WooCommerce Support – Duplicate products effortlessly if you’re running a WooCommerce store.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin after installation.
  6. Go to any Posts, Pages, or Custom Post Types list, and you will see the “Duplicate” link below each item.
sections.faq:
Can I duplicate custom post types?

Yes, the plugin supports duplication of all registered custom post types.

Where do I find the duplicate option?

Go to the admin list of posts, pages, or custom post types. Hover over an item, and you’ll see the Duplicate link.

Will it duplicate custom fields or meta?

Yes, all post meta and custom fields are duplicated.

Is this compatible with the block editor (Gutenberg)?

Yes, it works with both the Classic Editor and Gutenberg.

Can I restrict duplication to certain roles?

Not currently, but role-based permissions are on the roadmap for future updates.
